movement.reference_product: Envelope evidence only: M&P 56 x 56 x 17 mm class; selected movement shaft is user-specified 14 mm
movement.mounting: Use supplied movement nut and washer; no screws into printed plastic
movement.service: Slide clock off base, lift magnetic cover using lower finger notch, replace battery; no hinge.

dial_relief.clearance_status: Assembly target only; verify with actual movement and hands

dial_relief.component_structure: One watertight solid with no assembly children; integral relief rises from the 2.4 mm flat dial to 3.0 mm. White relief finish is applied by painting after printing, or by surface painting in a compatible slicer.

rounded_edges.intent: User requested smoothly rounded dial and body edges; central sweep plane and nesting seat are retained.

sliding_joint.retention: Identical captured T profiles and lower travel stops on both sides; no elastic detent or local socket.
sliding_joint.rear_locating_corner_match: R2 rail corner offset outward by 0.1 mm locating clearance

rear_service.release: 15 x 2 mm rectangular lower cover notch; no outer semicircular housing scallop
